prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image, up to 50,000 English characters. Refer to reference images as @image_1, @image_2, and so on.

images.description: Reference images for image-to-image: https URLs, data URIs or raw base64 (JPG or PNG, up to 30 MB, at least 300 px per side, aspect ratio between 2:5 and 5:2)

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image; auto picks one from the input
